# task-graph certificate fixtures

Real MegaM0 P0 pool objects (PeaceMaker persistent dispatchers hosting lifted
hipcc bodies as regions) and the standalone objects their regions were lifted
from. They are inputs of `tests/task_graph.rs`; nothing here is hand-written.

- `p0_r6_pool_b32.co`, `p0_r6_pool_b64.co`, `p0_r6_pool_b128.co`, `p0_r6_pool_b256.co`,
  `p0_r6_pool_b320.co`: one pool per blockDim, each with a `.note.pm_regions` table (b128 also
  hosts the native EXPAND_LIVE template 1, b256 the native COPY template 2, the lifted
  `hyper_norm_gate` template 3 and the 80-SGPR `gdn_step` template 5; b320 hosts the 10-wave
  `moe_shared_down_combine` template 19). These are the drained OR-poison pools
  (`Builder::drain_all_counters` before every region entry; watchdog poison = device-scope
  release `global_atomic_or_b32`, no swap) with the rows-6 full template set **and the
  dispatcher's span mode** (railgunmega/DYNAMIC.md: header flags/k/list-id words at +48/+52/+56,
  the `spans` table at M0Params +64, live-entry validation against the header grid, the claim
  bitmap, the NOP template `0xfffffffe`), generated by `pm_lift_pools` at the tip of
  `pmprereq/span` (`adb325e95c`) into `megam0/pmlift/out/span/`:
  b32 e6d3020e…, b64 b23f4d2a…, b128 f454b2c6…, b256 1236346e…, b320 193b727a… .
  (They replace the earlier static-only set of `pmprereq/uniform` `1bf5665101`.)
- `standalone/<sha256>.co`: the hipcc objects, named by the SHA-256 the notes record
  (`certify_pool`'s resolver looks them up by it; the digest is checked). Exactly the
  twelve digests the five pools reference.

All five pools certify `conditional` with the six required properties plus
`region_wg_from_header`, `span_entry_validated` and `region_wg_from_live_entry`; the shell's
three table-loaded accesses (count load, entry load, bitmap atomic) are attributed as a binding
arena on the `spans` argument (template `0xFFFFFFFE` for descriptor records: `+0 vmem_load`,
`+8 vmem_load`, `+16 atomic_commutative`; template `0xFFFFFFFD` for the `n_spans` header record).

b256 template 5 overwrites s72..s79 of the dispatcher range (its body's working set), so
the dispatcher parks `s72, s74..s79` in lanes `0, 2..7` of `v119` before the entry
(`v_writelane_b32 v119, sK, lane`) and restores them after the exit
(`v_readlane_b32 sK, v119, lane`); the certifier admits this only when proven
(`task_graph-region-sgpr-park`).

## Generator

From the repository root (CPU only), with MegaM0's rows-6 template table and its
standalone objects (`release-0.4.5/megam0/p0h/out`):

```
cargo run -p peacemaker-isa --features lab --example pm_lift_pools -- \
    TEMPLATES.json STANDALONE_DIR OUT_DIR
# TEMPLATES.json  = megam0/pmlift/out/span/templates_r6.json
# STANDALONE_DIR  = megam0/p0h/out/standalone   (one <name>/sa.co per object)
# OUT_DIR/p0_r6_pool_b<B>.co are the pools (megam0/pmlift/out/span/)
for f in STANDALONE_DIR/*/sa.co; do cp "$f" "standalone/$(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d' ' -f1).co"; done
```

(only the twelve objects the pools' notes reference are committed; the loop copies the
whole directory, the other objects are not needed here.) Build the generator on the
`pmprereq/span` branch at `adb325e95c` (the span dispatcher's source:
`crates/peacemaker-isa/src/kernels/lifted_dispatch_gfx1201.rs`, `span_entry`).

`lift_common::build_pools` tags every region (`lifted_dispatch_gfx1201::pool`
sets the template id and the lift provenance) and links with
`native::assemble_with_regions`, so the objects carry the region note.

Inspect an object with `railgun-cert pool-dump POOL.co`; certify one with
`railgun-cert pool --standalone standalone POOL.co` (add `--timings` for the per-phase
wall times and work counters; release builds certify each fixture pool in 0.2 to 2.6 s).
